strings.name: Natarajan Chandrasekaran
strings.summary: Chandrasekaran began in technical roles at Tata Consultancy Services, became CEO in 2009 and Tata Sons chairman in 2017. He helped direct manufacturing, software services and aviation investment, including Air India's acquisition. His tenure intersects with governance disputes: the Supreme Court reversed an order restoring his predecessor in 2021, while controlling trusts opposed a 2026 board decision renewing his appointment.
